verdict.rationale: Lago publishes a full public API reference with generated commands per endpoint, an OpenAPI 3.1 schema (verified live at /openapi.json), explicit versioning/stability guarantees, and docs/llms.txt aimed at AI-native consumption; it even documents an MCP server exposing billing data to AI agents. This is strong first-party and probe-verified evidence of a documented, machine-consumable public API. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials specifically about API usage/integration experience (community evidence is mostly about billing product value, not API DX).
